event.description: Train MQA ff16 only on full 10-digit operands
event.proposal: family: training control; retained incumbent is 3584 parameters at 99.1700%, a +0.17 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: attempt-0009, which raised the ff24 candidate from a 98.84% 15k result to 99.99% with a justified training-control change; same-family failed result: none; prior attempts in this family: 1. The latest architecture probe, attempt-0022, used MQA+ff16 at 3520 parameters and scored 98.50% after 30000 steps, a near miss. Hypothesis: the remaining error may be distributional because training mixed 1–10 digit operands while the official random cases use full-range 10-digit operands; set min_digits=max_digits=10 while changing no model parameters, and test whether the same 3520-parameter candidate crosses 99%. This is more informative than repeating 30000 mixed-digit steps because it changes the data exposure to match the qualification regime. Retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 3584 parameters.
